hook: Hyderabad gets a *new* police commissioner tonight
hook_b: Hyderabad gets a *new* police commissioner tonight
tldr: Telangana reshuffled senior IPS officers on Nov 12; Mahesh Muralidhar Bhagwat is Hyderabad's new Police Commissioner.

beats.what: Bhagwat replaces V.C. Sajjanar, who becomes DG of Telangana Fire, Disaster Response, Emergency and Civil Defence.
beats.why: The state issued a General Administration Department order moving top police officers across posts.
beats.care: The city commissioner heads policing, traffic and law and order for Hyderabad.

effects.label: New heads for ACB, SHE Teams

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Soumya Mishra moves to DGP, Women and Safety, SHE Teams and Bharosa; Charu Sinha now heads the ACB, per The Hindu.

cards.q: What should Hyderabad's new police chief focus on first?

qs: What changes for Hyderabad residents when a city police chief changes?
Which of these new postings touches daily life most: police, RTC or civil supplies?

facts.t: Akun Sabharwal, who was *awaiting a posting*, is now Additional DGP (Law and Order).
M. Stephen Raveendra now directs the state's *traffic, road and rail safety* bureau.

viz.verdict: New heads for city policing, women's safety, ACB and RTC

watch: When Bhagwat formally takes charge at the Commissionerate.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Major reshuffle of IPS officers in Telangana | Mahesh Bhagwat is new Commissioner of Hyderabad Police

fact: Mahesh Bhagwat replaces V.C. Sajjanar as *Hyderabad Police Commissioner* in a big IPS reshuffle.
twist: Sajjanar moves to head Fire, Disaster Response and Civil Defence; ex-Greyhounds chief Anil Kumar now runs *TGSRTC*, per The Hindu.
